target_text: // A VNNI K plane has no contiguous row view (Note [K VNNI storage]).
body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

Three lines sit above one STATIC_REQUIRE_FALSE. Line 1 restates `#ifdef TRON_K_VNNI` plus geometry_128 (the Note's gate), line 3 ("set_k_row / get_k_row serve the slot") maps to no code here and repeats the callee's comment. Line 2 is the one fact: the values of a token are not contiguous, so no row view.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // A VNNI K plane has no contiguous row view (Note [K VNNI storage]).
```
